parsed.name: BITalino 生理信号采集板
parsed.description: BITalino 是一款便携式蓝牙生理信号采集设备，提供多路模拟输入通道，可用于采集和传输实验中的生理或其他低频模拟传感器信号。它常用于教学、原型开发和可穿戴生理测量实验。
parsed.description_en: BITalino is a portable Bluetooth biosignal acquisition device with multiple analog input channels for collecting and streaming physiological or other low-frequency analog sensor signals in laboratory experiments. It is commonly used for teaching, prototyping, and wearable physiology measurements.

actions.description: 连接到 BITalino 设备并订阅其实时数据流。
actions.description_en: Connect to the BITalino device and subscribe to its live data stream.

actions.description: 停止数据流并断开与 BITalino 设备的连接。
actions.description_en: Stop the data stream and disconnect from the BITalino device.

actions.description: 设置用于接收设备实时采样数据的回调函数。
actions.description_en: Set a callback function to receive real-time sample data from the device.

actions.description: 设置采样率和通道后，开始从设备采集数据。
actions.description_en: Configure the sampling rate and channels, then start data acquisition from the device.
Stop data acquisition on the device.
